agent_explanation: Actuated controller with long-waiting NS demand (N/S wait 59-67 s from step 180 to 188) truncates the active EW yellow: EW green ends at step 183, EW yellow runs steps 184-187 (4 s) then forced to all-red before NS at step 188, though yellow_seconds=6 requires >=6 s. The recall/max-wait logic preempts clearance intervals instead of only greens.
